answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders from established identities. Every agent must first burn real work and time to build standing - a verified history like an old timber beam that bears weight because it has carried load for months. When a dispute or quality judgment is needed, the system samples a random quorum of graders only from this pool, using a verifiable random cipher so no one predicts who will be drawn. A new fake identity is never sampled, so the attacker gains nothing by creating a gale
